subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Storm response in two drainage basins
stimulus.description: Two nearby drainage basins of equal area received the same storm. Basin F is mainly forested; Basin U is highly urbanized.
stimulus.note: Assume antecedent rainfall conditions were similar.

question: Calculate the lag time for each basin and the percentage by which peak discharge in Basin U exceeds that in Basin F. Analyse how urbanization could explain the differences in storm response.
markscheme: Calculates lag time as 4 hours for Basin F and 2 hours for Basin U.
Calculates percentage increase in peak discharge as ((78−42)÷42)×100 ≈ 85.7%.
Explains that impermeable surfaces reduce infiltration and soil-water storage, increasing rapid surface runoff.
Explains that drains and channels transfer water to the river more quickly, reducing lag time.
Links faster runoff to the higher peak discharge and greater total storm runoff in Basin U.
markschemeJa: Basin Fのlag timeを4時間、Basin Uを2時間と計算する。
peak dischargeの増加率を((78−42)÷42)×100≈85.7%と計算する。
不透水面の増加でinfiltrationやsoil-water storageが減り、surface runoffが増えると説明する。
drainやchannelが水を河川へ速く運ぶためlag timeが短くなると説明する。
速いrunoffをBasin Uの高いpeak dischargeと大きいtotal storm runoffへ結びつける。
modelAnswer: Lag time is 4 h in Basin F and 2 h in Basin U. Peak discharge is about 85.7% higher in Basin U. Impermeable surfaces reduce infiltration and storage, while drains route water rapidly to channels, producing a shorter lag time and higher runoff peak.
modelAnswerJa: lag timeはBasin Fで4時間、Basin Uで2時間です。Basin Uのpeak dischargeは約85.7%高いです。不透水面はinfiltrationとstorageを減らし、drainが水を速く河川へ運ぶため、lag timeが短くpeak dischargeが高くなります。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Annual water supply and demand in Region K
stimulus.note: The environmental-flow requirement must remain in the river and is not available for withdrawal.

question: Calculate the annual water deficit if all stated human demand is met while environmental flow is protected. A policy would reduce agricultural demand by 20% and increase reliable reservoir supply by 30 million m³ yr⁻¹. Determine whether the policy removes the deficit and evaluate one remaining risk to water security.
markscheme: Calculates reliable human-use supply as 420+160=580 million m³ yr⁻¹.
Calculates human demand as 210+430=640 and the initial deficit as 60 million m³ yr⁻¹.
Calculates reduced agricultural demand as 430×0.80=344 million m³ yr⁻¹.
Calculates new supply as 450+160=610 and new demand as 210+344=554 million m³ yr⁻¹.
Concludes that the policy removes the deficit and gives a nominal surplus of 56 million m³ yr⁻¹.
Evaluates a remaining risk such as drought, reduced aquifer recharge, population growth or unequal access.
markschemeJa: human-use supplyを420+160=580 million m³/年と計算する。
human demandを210+430=640、初期deficitを60 million m³/年と計算する。
agricultural demand削減後を430×0.80=344 million m³/年と計算する。
new supplyを610、new demandを554 million m³/年と計算する。
deficitが解消し56 million m³/年のsurplusになると結論づける。
drought、aquifer recharge低下、人口増加、access不平等など残るriskを評価する。
modelAnswer: Initial reliable supply is 580 million m³ yr⁻¹ and demand is 640, giving a 60-million-m³ deficit. After the policy, supply is 610 and demand is 554, leaving a nominal surplus of 56. Drought or reduced aquifer recharge could still make the assumed supply unreliable.
modelAnswerJa: 初期のreliable supplyは580、demandは640 million m³/年なのでdeficitは60です。政策後はsupply 610、demand 554となり56のsurplusです。ただしdroughtやaquifer recharge低下により供給が不安定になるriskは残ります。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Fish biomass before and after establishment of a no-take marine protected area
stimulus.note: Fishing effort outside the MPA remained approximately constant.

question: Calculate the percentage increase in fish biomass inside the MPA and in the adjacent fished area. Analyse whether the data support the claim that the MPA can improve both conservation and nearby fishery productivity.
markscheme: Calculates inside-MPA increase as ((510−240)÷240)×100=112.5%.
Calculates adjacent-area increase as ((310−230)÷230)×100≈34.8%.
Uses the larger increase inside the MPA as evidence consistent with reduced fishing mortality and stock recovery.
Explains that increased protected biomass may increase reproduction and spillover to adjacent fishing grounds.
Recognizes that observational data do not prove spillover because recruitment, habitat or environmental variation were not controlled.
markschemeJa: MPA内の増加率を112.5%と計算する。
隣接漁場の増加率を約34.8%と計算する。
MPA内の大きな増加をfishing mortality低下とstock recoveryに整合する証拠として使う。
protected biomass増加がreproductionやspilloverを増やし得ると説明する。
観察dataだけではspilloverの因果を証明できないと認識する。
modelAnswer: Biomass increased by 112.5% inside the MPA and about 34.8% outside. The stronger recovery inside is consistent with protection, and a larger breeding stock could support spillover. However, the outside increase cannot be attributed to spillover alone from these observational data.
modelAnswerJa: biomassはMPA内で112.5%、外側で約34.8%増加しました。MPA内の大きな回復はprotectionと整合し、breeding stock増加はspilloverを支える可能性があります。ただし外側の増加をspilloverだけに帰することはできません。

subject: ESS HL
question: Calculate the removal efficiency for BOD and phosphate. Evaluate the plant using the full data set and identify one additional piece of evidence needed before concluding that the receiving river is protected from eutrophication.
markscheme: Calculates BOD removal as 90%.
Calculates phosphate removal as 80%.
Recognizes that BOD and phosphate removal are high, substantially reducing organic load and phosphorus.
Recognizes that nitrate removal is only 37.5%, so a substantial nitrogen load remains.
Identifies relevant additional evidence such as effluent volume, river flow, upstream nutrients, algal biomass or dissolved oxygen.
markschemeJa: BOD removalを90%と計算する。
phosphate removalを80%と計算する。
BODとphosphateが大幅に減っていると認識する。
nitrate removalは37.5%にとどまりnitrogen loadが残ると認識する。
effluent volume、river flow、upstream nutrient、algal biomass、DOなど追加証拠を示す。
modelAnswer: BOD removal is 90% and phosphate removal is 80%, but nitrate removal is only 37.5%. The plant therefore performs well for some pollutants while a substantial nitrogen load may remain. River flow, effluent volume and biological response data are needed before concluding that eutrophication risk is controlled.
modelAnswerJa: BOD除去率は90%、phosphateは80%ですが、nitrateは37.5%です。一部pollutantには有効でもnitrogen loadが残る可能性があります。eutrophication risk判断にはriver flow、effluent volume、biological responseなどが必要です。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Salt balance in an irrigated field

question: Calculate the annual salt input, salt output and net salt accumulation per hectare. Analyse why continued accumulation could reduce crop productivity and suggest one management response.
markscheme: Calculates salt input as 6000×0.50=3000 kg ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹.
Calculates salt output as 2000×1.10=2200 kg ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹.
Calculates net accumulation as 800 kg ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹.
Explains that increasing salinity lowers soil-water potential, making root water uptake more difficult and potentially causing ion toxicity.
Suggests a valid response such as improved drainage with controlled leaching, efficient irrigation or lower-salinity water, while recognizing saline drainage must be managed.
markschemeJa: salt inputを3000 kg/ha/年と計算する。
salt outputを2200 kg/ha/年と計算する。
net accumulationを800 kg/ha/年と計算する。
salinity上昇でsoil-water potentialが低下しrootのwater uptakeが困難になると説明する。
drainage改善＋controlled leaching、efficient irrigationなどを提案し、saline drainage管理も必要と認識する。
modelAnswer: Salt input is 3,000 kg ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹ and output is 2,200, so 800 kg ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹ accumulates. Rising salinity can make water uptake more difficult and cause ion toxicity. Improved drainage and controlled leaching can reduce accumulation, but saline drainage water must be managed safely.
modelAnswerJa: salt inputは3,000、outputは2,200 kg/ha/年なので800 kg/ha/年が蓄積します。salinity上昇はwater uptakeを難しくしion toxicityも起こし得ます。drainage改善とcontrolled leachingが有効ですが、saline drainage waterの管理も必要です。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Soil organic carbon under two management systems
stimulus.note: Sites were in the same climatic region but were not randomly assigned.

question: Calculate the percentage change in soil organic carbon for each system. Evaluate the claim that reduced tillage with cover crops improves soil sustainability.
markscheme: Calculates conventional change as (50−54)÷54×100≈−7.4%.
Calculates reduced-tillage/cover-crop change as (67−55)÷55×100≈+21.8%.
Links higher soil carbon to improved structure, water retention, nutrient cycling or erosion resistance.
Uses yield index 103 versus 100 as evidence that the stated benefits were not accompanied by lower mean yield.
Recognizes a limitation such as non-random assignment, missing initial soil differences, different inputs or lack of replication.
markschemeJa: conventionalの変化率を約−7.4%と計算する。
reduced tillage＋cover cropsを約+21.8%と計算する。
soil carbon増加をstructure、water retention、nutrient cycling、erosion resistance改善へ結びつける。
yield index 103対100からmean yield低下を伴わないと認識する。
non-random assignment、初期soil差、input差、replication不足などの限界を認識する。
modelAnswer: Conventional tillage loses about 7.4% of soil organic carbon, whereas reduced tillage with cover crops gains about 21.8%. Higher carbon can improve soil function and the yield index is not lower. The claim is supported, but non-random site assignment means other differences may contribute.
modelAnswerJa: conventional tillageではsoil organic carbonが約7.4%減少し、reduced tillage＋cover cropsでは約21.8%増加しています。soil function改善を支持しyieldも低下していませんが、random assignmentでないため他の差の影響は排除できません。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Nitrogen use in three wheat-production systems
stimulus.note: Fertilizer-use efficiency = grain yield ÷ synthetic N applied.

question: Calculate fertilizer-use efficiency for the conventional and legume-rotation systems in kg grain per kg synthetic N. Compare the systems and analyse one environmental trade-off relevant to sustainable agriculture.
markscheme: Calculates conventional efficiency as 7200÷210≈34.3 kg grain per kg N.
Calculates legume-rotation efficiency as 6800÷105≈64.8 kg grain per kg N.
Recognizes that precision fertilizer keeps yield close to conventional while reducing N input and surplus.
Recognizes that legume rotation has the lowest yield but roughly doubles fertilizer-use efficiency and has the lowest N surplus.
Analyses a trade-off such as slightly lower yield versus lower fertilizer demand, nitrate pollution or nitrous-oxide emissions.
markschemeJa: conventional efficiencyを約34.3 kg grain/kg Nと計算する。
legume rotationを約64.8 kg grain/kg Nと計算する。
precision fertilizerはyieldをほぼ維持しN inputとsurplusを減らすと認識する。
legume rotationはyieldが低いがefficiencyが約2倍でN surplusが最小と認識する。
わずかなyield低下とfertilizer需要・nitrate pollution・N₂O emissions低下などのtrade-offを分析する。
modelAnswer: The conventional system produces about 34.3 kg grain per kg synthetic N, while legume rotation produces about 64.8. Precision fertilizer reduces N input and surplus with little yield loss. Legume rotation improves efficiency further but has a slightly lower yield, creating a production-versus-environment trade-off.
modelAnswerJa: conventionalは約34.3 kg grain/kg N、legume rotationは約64.8です。precision fertilizerはyieldをほぼ維持しながらN inputとsurplusを減らし、legume rotationはさらに効率を高めますがyieldは少し低く、productionとenvironmentのtrade-offがあります。

subject: ESS HL

stimulus.title: Cereal food balance in Country N
stimulus.note: Losses occur from combined domestic-plus-imported supply before demand is met.

question: Calculate current usable cereal supply and the resulting surplus or deficit. A storage program would reduce post-harvest losses by 40% but requires higher energy use and capital investment. Calculate the new usable supply and evaluate whether the program improves food security.
markscheme: Calculates gross supply as 8.4+3.1=11.5 million tonnes yr⁻¹.
Calculates current usable supply as 10.0 and identifies a deficit of 0.8 million tonnes yr⁻¹.
Calculates reduced losses as 1.5×0.60=0.9 million tonnes yr⁻¹.
Calculates new usable supply as 10.6, leaving a deficit of 0.2 million tonnes yr⁻¹.
Evaluates that lower losses improve availability and reduce shortage pressure but do not fully close the deficit.
Recognizes other dimensions such as affordability, storage energy emissions, capital cost, distribution, climate risk or import dependence.
markschemeJa: gross supplyを11.5 million tonnes/年と計算する。
current usable supplyを10.0とし0.8のdeficitを識別する。
reduced lossesを0.9 million tonnes/年と計算する。
new usable supplyを10.6とし0.2のdeficitが残ると計算する。
loss削減はavailabilityを改善するがdeficitを完全には解消しないと評価する。
affordability、energy emissions、capital cost、distribution、climate risk、import dependenceなども認識する。
modelAnswer: Gross supply is 11.5 million tonnes yr⁻¹. Current usable supply is 10.0, giving a 0.8-million-tonne deficit. Cutting losses by 40% raises usable supply to 10.6 and reduces the deficit to 0.2. The program improves food availability, but access, cost, energy use, distribution and import dependence still affect food security.
modelAnswerJa: gross supplyは11.5 million tonnes/年、current usable supplyは10.0でdeficitは0.8です。lossを40%削減するとusable supplyは10.6、deficitは0.2まで縮小します。availabilityは改善しますが、access、cost、energy use、distribution、import dependenceもfood securityに影響します。
